record.question: Average annual growth rate of India's Agriculture and allied sector during the Eleventh Five Year Plan is:
record.explanation: Answer D: 3.6%. The Economic Survey 2012–13 paragraph 1.80 reports average agriculture-and-allied growth during the Eleventh Plan as 3.6%; the Prime Minister repeated 3.6% in July 2013. Thus D is the supported printed choice for that contemporary published estimate. Official series/vintages can differ: Twelfth Plan table 2.1 reports 3.7%, so the explanation must name the estimate rather than present 3.6 as invariant. Historical/source note: 3.6% is the Economic Survey 2012–13 contemporary estimate; another official table reports 3.7%, which is not a printed option. Reference: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/budget2013-2014/es2012-13/echap-01.pdf; https://www.mofpi.gov.in/sites/default/files/vol_1.pdf.pdf12thfiveyearplan.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
